info.name: AI Client Acquisition System v3
info.description:
Full API collection including AI lead scoring.
Base URL: http://localhost:3000

Quick start:
1. Create a lead → lead_id auto-saved
2. POST /api/score-lead → AI scores and saves result
3. GET /api/score-lead/ranked → see all scored leads
